name: Third-Party & Vendor
description: Due diligence, contract protections and ongoing monitoring of suppliers.

items.text: Vendor is tiered by criticality and data access
items.guidance: Depth of due diligence should match the tier.

items.text: Financial stability of the vendor has been assessed
items.guidance: Review credit reports or audited accounts for critical vendors.

items.text: Security questionnaire or certification (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2) is reviewed
items.guidance: Follow up on any qualified opinions or exceptions.

items.text: Sanctions and adverse media screening is completed
items.guidance: Screen the vendor entity and its beneficial owners.

items.text: Service levels and remedies are defined in the contract
items.guidance: Include measurable SLAs and service credits.

items.text: Right to audit and security obligations are included
items.guidance: Require notification of security incidents affecting your data.

items.text: Exit plan and data return or deletion terms are agreed
items.guidance: Plan how services transition if the relationship ends.

items.text: Liability caps and insurance cover are reviewed by legal
items.guidance: Ensure caps are proportionate to potential losses.

items.text: Vendor performance is reviewed against SLAs regularly
items.guidance: Hold quarterly reviews for critical vendors.
Ask critical vendors to disclose key sub-processors.

items.text: Vendor risk assessments are refreshed on a defined cycle
items.guidance: Annually for critical vendors, every two to three years otherwise.
